_comment: What differs per copy of the app (v36.72). The LIVE copy's settings are the #appConfig block in index.html itself, so 'live' changes nothing. Every other copy lists only what is different; tools/build.js writes it into its own copy of the page. Nothing here is secret: a Firebase web key only works from the addresses allowed for it in Google Cloud.

test._why_iosShortcutUrl: v37.40 — Tony's "Save to My Kitchen Notes (TEST)" shortcut (2 Oct 2026): opens this copy's ?url=. The family's own link is in index.html.
test._why_dataLayout: WP-D rehearsal (28 Sep 2026): the test copy runs in the household layout after Tony copied its collection into a household (Family Access → Copy this collection into a household). Its `shared` collection is untouched; setting this back to 'shared' returns to it.
test._why_extensionStores: v37.73 — the stores list the FAMILY's extension; this copy offers its own download (my-kitchen-notes-extension-TEST.zip), never the family's listing.
test._why_diagnostics: v37.09 — Tony: logging and debugging on in the test copy, so any report he sends carries the log. His own switch, once used on a device, is kept.
test._why_signIn: v37.03 — the test copy tries the other ways to sign in first: a password and an e-mailed link (Firebase → Authentication → Sign-in method). Microsoft is built but OFF: registering the app in Azure needs a directory (tenant) that a personal Outlook account does not have, and e-mail sign-in covers work addresses — Tony, 28 Sep 2026: skip Microsoft and Apple for now (Apple becomes REQUIRED for an iPhone App Store app that offers Google sign-in). Apple waits for an Apple Developer account.
test._why_authDomain: Sign-in runs on the test copy's own address (v36.75; v36.78 self-hosted). On an iPhone, sign-in on tonys-recipes-test.firebaseapp.com fails with 'missing initial state'. tools/build.js fetches Firebase's sign-in files into dist/__/ because authDomain equals this copy's own host. Google must list https://tonys-recipes-test.pages.dev/__/auth/handler as an allowed redirect.
test._why_brand: Its own icons (tools/make-test-icons.mjs) and a teal tab icon, so the test copy cannot be mistaken for the family's app on a home screen or in a browser tab.
test._why_bringDirect_off: Bring!'s own import (feature 'bring', v36.89) is safe here — it opens the tester's own Bring! app. Sending straight to a list ('bringDirect') goes through the Worker's token to the family's real list, so it stays off.
test._why_feedbackButton: v37.64 — the floating 💬 note, tried here before the testers get it.

beta._why: v37.59 — the BETA copy (design step 5): the testers' own app, with its own Firebase project and site, built from the `beta` branch, which moves forward only when Tony says (like the family's). Tony, 3 Oct 2026: a beta copy and a per-household AI cap.
beta._why_firebase: Tony's beta Firebase project (4 Oct 2026). authDomain is the copy's OWN address, not my-kitchen-notes-beta.firebaseapp.com: sign-in is served from it (tools/build.js fetches Firebase's sign-in files into dist/__/), as for the test copy — on an iPhone the firebaseapp.com address fails with 'missing initial state'.
beta._why_iosShortcutUrl: v37.72 — Tony's beta shortcut (5 Oct 2026): a copy of his, pointed at this address.
beta._why_extensionStores: v37.97 — Tony: the store extension leads to the beta now (extension 1.7: My Kitchen Notes for everyone, the family app for whoever opens it in that browser), so the beta offers the store listing. (v37.73–96: its own download, my-kitchen-notes-extension-BETA.zip.)
beta._why_features: Testers get nearly everything, so there is feedback on more of it (Tony, 4 Oct 2026). WhatsApp ON (each tester's own exported chats; the family's repository-folder field is hidden in every copy but the family's). Off: sending to a Bring! list (it is the family's list, through the Worker's token) and Gmail (Google reviews that permission before it may be offered to the public). The floating 💬 note to Tony is on (v37.64).
beta._why_diagnostics: Logging on, so ✉️ Send feedback from a tester carries the log.
beta._why_brand: Its own violet icons with a BETA band (tools/make-test-icons.mjs beta) and a small 'Beta' mark instead of the test copy's warning stripes: testers are real users of their own recipes.
